marta: Heads-up — starting argo13b-lite onboarding. Weights uploaded to s3://redwood-models/argo13b-lite/v1/ (check manifests). Seeing tokenizer splitting on hyphens oddly and config validator failing on max_seq_len mismatch. Can someone run a quick smoke perf (bs 1/4/8, seq 512) and sanity-check configs?
ryan: I can take perf. Confirmed weights path exists. Tokenizer that came with the weights is v1; our service expects vocab-based merges from tokenizer v2. That explains weird splits (e.g., 'state-of-the-art' -> ["state","-","of","-","the","-","art"]). Recommend swapping to tokenizer_v2.json in the model bundle.
anika: I'll run on dev-dedicated (gpu-pool-g4dn-small) this afternoon. Quick command I'll use:
```
./tools/bench_run \
  --model s3://redwood-models/argo13b-lite/v1/ \
  --Tokenizer tokenizer_v2.json \
  --batch-sizes 1,4,8 \
  --seq-len 512 \
  --iters 300 \
  --quant none \
  --out perf/argo13b-lite-smoke.json
```
sam: Small infra notes — make sure service config uses max_batch_size: 8 and batch_timeout_ms: 10. Also set USE_KV_CACHE=true in the model runtime env. Model config lives at infra/model_config/argo13b-lite.yaml; I pushed a small template change in https://git.redwood/infra/+/r/1223 (PR 1223).
marta: Thanks. Also the config validator was complaining about model.max_input_len: bundle says 4096 but runtime default is 2048. Which should we settle on?
ryan: For the lite variant we should cap at 2048 to keep mem footprint predictable. I'll update the bundle manifest to set max_input_len: 2048 and reupload.
anika: Perf results (initial smoke, dev-dedicated, single GPU g4dn):
- bs=1: p50=210ms, p95=340ms, throughput= 42 tok/s (seq512 sample)
- bs=4: p50=360ms, p95=620ms, throughput=160 tok/s
- bs=8: p50=680ms, p95=1450ms (spikes), throughput=240 tok/s
Observations: steady throughput increase but p95 jumps at bs=8 — looks like occasional mem GC/queueing. Will run another with batch-size 6 and measure.
sam: Noted. I saw a kernel allocation spike in node logs around the same time as your bs=8 p95, likely due to concurrency hitting a fallback path. I applied a small limit change to per-device concurrency in the runtime: CONCURRENCY_PER_DEVICE=2 (commit c4a9f3b). Should reduce those spikes.
marta: Great. Ryan, can you update the model bundle tokenizer to v2 and the manifest max_input_len before anika's next run?
ryan: Done — uploaded tokenizer_v2.json and manifest v1.1 to same s3 path. checksum: sha256:6a7b... Updated catalog draft with note about tokenizer change.
anika: Reran bs=6 per sam's change and with updated tokenizer + manifest:
- bs=6: p50=420ms, p95=680ms, throughput=210 tok/s
P95 much better. No tokenization regressions on the eval set.
qa-bot: Checklist: model bundle present ✅, tokenizer match ✅, manifest validation ✅, smoke perf completed ✅. Ready for catalog entry review.
marta: Awesome — moving to catalog review queue. Thanks everyone :rocket:
